quest.title: Gold Devouring and Mora Gathering
quest.description: Hatim, a rich fellow from Kalimi, seemed to be bothered by something...

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: Let me think... Which should I pick?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: Oh, I'm wondering what today's "Golden Dish" is going to be.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A "Golden Dish"? Is that... food that's made of gold?

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: No, it's a great dish that will increase the affinity of those who consume it for Mora!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon wants to eat it too! Wait... But how can there be such a thing?

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: Haha, come, there is much you do not know.

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: Let's take Liyue's Mora Meat as an example. This renowned dish was named after money, and this of course strongly implies an association with financial fortune.

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: And there's Butter Chicken too! Its sumptuous oil just conjures up the image of a full wallet.

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: Another example is Mondstadt's "Pile 'Em Up"! From the name itself, it is surely a symbol of rising wealth.

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: So if you eat this kind of dish, then go to the Kalimi Exchange to buy some futures contracts, you'd be sure to make a killing!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The explanation sounds sort of contrived...

response.speaker: Hatim
response.text: Never bought 'em, have you? Hmm... Let me explain it to you. It's a kind of futures trading that corresponds to spot trading. For example, this little one next to you...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon is Paimon! Not some "little one"!

response.speaker: Hatim
response.text: Hahaha! Then, little Paimon, what do you like?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Paimon likes... Um... Slimes!

response.speaker: Hatim
response.text: Hahaha! Alright, then! Let's suppose I have a type of Slime Condensate in my hand, priced at 100 Mora a bottle.

response.speaker: Hatim
response.text: If you buy 500 bottles of Slime Condensate from me for 50,000 Mora today, that would be considered a spot deal.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Th—That's too many! Paimon can't eat all of that!

response.speaker: Hatim
response.text: This is just an analogy... Suppose you buy 500 bottles today. However, you can't guarantee that you will buy that much Slime Condensate from me every day, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um... Well, Paimon's not gonna buy any if she's too full.

response.speaker: Hatim
response.text: That's right, and I for my part can't guarantee that I will be able to supply you with that much Slime Condensate whenever you want.

response.speaker: Hatim
response.text: So, this is when futures come into play. Futures are not your run-of-the-mill face-to-face trading, but a "trading agreement."

response.speaker: Hatim
response.text: "Buying a bottle of Slime Condensate" and "selling a bottle of Slime Condensate" are both types of "trading agreements."

response.speaker: Hatim
response.text: When I can supply Slime Condensate, I will submit a "trading agreement" to the Futures Exchange to sell that condensate.

response.speaker: Hatim
response.text: When you need the Slime Condensate, you can go to the Futures Exchange and check the "trading agreements" to see who's selling it.

response.speaker: Hatim
response.text: "Futures trading" involves cleverly buying and selling these "trading agreements" to reap profits.

response.speaker: Hatim
response.text: Of course, this is just an analogy. If Slime Condensate was really traded on the futures market, all wild slimes would now be extinct.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow... Amazing...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Uh... I don't get it...

response.speaker: Hatim
response.text: However! The futures market is ever-changing, and even a seasoned veteran such as I cannot guarantee that the futures I buy will profit.

response.speaker: Hatim
response.text: But if you eat the "Golden Dish" that brings fortune before buying your futures, the situation will be different. The only question is... Which one should I eat today?

response.speaker: Hatim
response.text: Ah, hold on, I didn't notice earlier, but your hair... It's actually the color of gold! Dazzling! Dazzling, I say!

response.speaker: Hatim
response.text: Gold is a symbol of wealth, and so the dish *you* choose will surely bring me lots of fortune!

response.speaker: Hatim
response.text: Why don't you help me choose a "Golden Dish"? I will repay you well.

response.speaker: Hatim
response.text: I'll give you extra perks too if I make Mora off this. How about it?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: But what if you lose...?

response.speaker: Hatim
response.text: Hahaha! Don't worry, I, the exceptionally rich Hatim of Kalimi, hereby declare that you shall get a share of any profits and that all losses will be fully borne by me, so you can rest assured.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I see.

response.speaker: Hatim
response.text: Come, make the choice for me, then. <color=#00E1FFFF>Mora Meat</color>, <color=#00E1FFFF>Butter Chicken</color>, or <color=#00E1FFFF>"Pile 'Em Up"</color>, which one is the real Golden Dish?

response.speaker: Hatim
response.text: Mix up all the good ingredients, and you shall end up with a dish most dubious. This happens distressingly often, does it not?

response.speaker: Hatim
response.text: Fortune is like that too. Eating all of them will only be counterproductive, so we must choose the most effective "Golden Dish" to consume!

talks.objective: Help Hatim select a Golden Dish

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: How's about it, then? <color=#00E1FFFF>Mora Meat</color>, <color=#00E1FFFF>Butter Chicken</color>, or <color=#00E1FFFF>Pile 'Em Up</color>? Let me hear your choice.

talks.objective: Help Hatim select a Golden Dish

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: Oh, I can smell it! This dish smells like... wealth! Yes, it smells like gold! I shall make a killing this time, yes indeed!

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: Thank you so much. Now, I shall go to my "Wealth Spot" later and eat this "Golden Dish." Just wait to hear good news from me, you two!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: "Wealth Spot"?

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: This is another one of my secret ways to get rich, and like the "Golden Dish," this is a good location that can bring me fortune.

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: See the city gate over there? Countless merchants carry their goods and Mora through it every day... That place must be teeming with fortunes.

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: Also, the area around the Exchange is also where Mora gathers. If you spend lots of time in such places, you will be blessed with wealth!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You have so many strange theories.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This all seems rather baseless...

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: Hahaha! Strange or not, nonsense or not, any theory that makes me Mora is a good one.

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: Okay, I'm ready to embrace my fortune. Wait for good news from me, Traveler!

talks.objective: Help Hatim select a Golden Dish

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You're not picking a Golden Dish again, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: Hahaha, a clever little brain you have! That's right. I'm about to pick one Golden Dish to rule all futures markets!

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: So, help me out again, would you?
